archetypes.name: doc-table-consistency
archetypes.rationale: The plan removes multiple LOOP_STATUS values and adds exit 14 across ~8 interlocking .md files and SKILL.md; any table or enum that stays out of sync silently breaks the branch matrix or exit-code contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every exit-code table, LOOP_STATUS enum, and branch-matrix row that the plan modifies or that references the removed statuses (converged, cap-hit, revision-failed, emit-plan-failed, plan-size-trigger, plan-validator-defects) and the new exit 14 (drift). Check that the set of exit codes in flags.md, approval-gates.md, discussion-rounds.md, plan-review-loop.md, run-step3-review.md, and SKILL.md are mutually consistent — no table still lists a removed status, no table omits the new exit 14. Verify that the LOOP_STATUS validation regex in run-step3-review.sh and the SKILL.md Step 3 branch matrix cover exactly the same reduced enum with no gaps or phantom entries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: flag-removal-atomicity
archetypes.rationale: Removing --manual/manual_gate_b requires atomically updating parse-design-argv.sh KV count (8→7), SKILL.md Step 0-pre guard, write-run-params.sh, design-init-runparams.sh, design-route.sh resume path, and write-design-current-env.sh; missing any one consumer breaks every /design run.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the full propagation path of the --manual / manual_gate_b removal: parse-design-argv.sh KV output count, SKILL.md Step 0-pre success-KV-count guard (the plan says 8→7), write-run-params.sh schema field drop, design-init-runparams.sh --manual-requested arg drop, design-route.sh resume-env-refresh stale-field read, and write-design-current-env.sh MANUAL_REQUESTED emission. Verify the plan accounts for every file that reads or writes manual_gate_b or MANUAL_REQUESTED, including test harnesses that assert the old KV count or pass --manual in test argv. Check whether any script outside the listed scope-files could still pass --manual-requested to write-design-current-env.sh or design-init-runparams.sh after the change. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
